coverage_model.note: Approximate buffered-swath model before detailed connector and asymmetric chute validation.

alternatives.name: Adjacent-lane snake
alternatives.turns_or_connectors: 6 compact end turns; 1 affected stripe bypass; perimeter pole loop
alternatives.risk: Adjacent 0.965 m lane changes need compact omega/keyhole-like turns; feasibility at 1.4 m is unproven.

alternatives.name: Three-lane skip phases
alternatives.turns_or_connectors: radius-friendly skip turns plus two phase relocations; affected stripe bypass; perimeter pole loop
alternatives.risk: Phase changes create long relocation connectors and may cross finished cuts or require perimeter travel.

alternatives.name: Same-direction stripes with perimeter returns
alternatives.turns_or_connectors: 6 perimeter returns; no immediate adjacent-lane U-turn; affected stripe bypass; pole loop
alternatives.risk: Longest route; repeated perimeter traffic may rut and each return must merge safely into the next stripe.
